text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the momentous GⅠ race, the 
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Worrying that Fusaichi Pandora might get 
nervous, I prepared some snacks and 
magazines she'd like and set off, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if there was never any need to worry, 
she was completely absorbed in watching 
anime.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...*haaah*~~! Man, that was intense~! The 
absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
PriFigh 2! It's an older one, but it was 
streaming for free and trending online, so 
I got curious~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
PriFigh—short for "Bakusou 
Mouhime☆Princess Fighter"—is a hugely 
popular anime for young girls about an 
elegant Umamusume princess who protects 
the world.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I used to love it so much~! Especially 
that sparkly blonde girl who shows up 
midway through, she was my absolute fave♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
This character! She's totally sassy and 
unmotivated at first, right? But then one 
day, the enemy kidnaps all her friends!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It was insane! Like, crazy strong. So you 
gotta work super hard to grow, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"And then, she works super hard at the 
end... and defeats the enemy almost all by 
herself! Isn't that amazing!?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Riiight~!? Ahh, my motivation is totally 
maxed out! I'm so glad I watched it♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be cool like PreFie, and cool like 
Kuu-chan-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, let's get fired up for the 
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She probably didn't watch it just to boost 
her motivation... but it's great that her 
lifted spirits are now focused squarely on 
the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, ever since that day, 
slight changes could be seen in our daily 
training as well.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hmph, hmph, Grrr, this is tough!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Just a little more! Just a little more 
and it's over...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally she'd want to quit strength 
training as soon as she got tired, but she 
saw it through properly to the end—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? "I forgot your reward, so I'm going 
back to the trainer's office to get it"?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It's fine for today. I'll run properly 
even without it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even without a reward, you tackled your 
training properly. Perhaps thanks to 
that...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Teyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Phew, and done! How was that, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh!? A new personal best!? For!! Real!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~♡ Right? I'm totally a genius, 
huh~♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having prepared without a hitch, she was 
able to face today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to when we first formed our 
contract, this is a huge step forward...!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Whoa, creepy, why are you tearing 
up?"
choice_data_list:
I was just thinking how much you've 
grown...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? From just that? Wait, you're crying 
over that~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...How weird~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could this be called a graduation ceremony 
of sorts? I want to bear witness to 
Fusaichi Pandora's growth in the Junior 
Class through this race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is about to 
begin!
